newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 19.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 19.50 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates ended a shade lower on Tuesday in a balanced market, traders said.
Overnight rates quickly dropped to 19.25 percent compared with Monday's close of 19.625 percent but bounced back to close at 19.50 percent.
"Money was coming from and going back to the central bank's reverse repo facility," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
He added that Monday's tax payment did not drain the market, which also moved today due to unusual behaviour of one participant.
"One not too large bank, that usually takes up money, was on the offering side today," Tolonics said.
However, he added that the market as a whole was fairly well balanced.
"If overnight rates move within a one percent range as they did for the last week, that can be considered a balanced market," Tolonics said.
Hungary's overnight rates tend to hover around the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate, currently standing at 20.00 percent.
